legend: Luke likes math problems, so he has asked you to solve this problem.
Given a vector $$$\langle x,y \rangle$$$, what is the total number of nonempty sequences of vectors $$$\{a_i\}_{i=0}^n$$$ such that:
All vectors in $$$\{a_i\}$$$ have only integer entries.
Moreover, he will give you $$$Q$$$ queries, and you need to output the answer for each of these $$$\mod 10^9 + 7$$$ (a prime).
Note that for vector $$$v$$$ of dimension $$$n$$$, $$$||v||_2 = \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^n v_i^2}$$$.
input: An integer $$$Q$$$, $$$1 \leq Q \leq 10^6$$$ which gives the number of queries. $$$Q$$$ lines follow, each with two space separated integers $$$x_i$$$ and $$$y_i$$$, $$$0 \leq |x_i|, |y_i| \leq 10^6$$$, representing the $$$i$$$th query.
output: On the $$$i$$$th line output the total number of nonempty sequence of vectors that satisfy the above properties for $$$\langle x_i,y_i \rangle$$$.

legend.ai: Luke 喜欢数学题，所以他请你解决这道题。
给定一个向量 $$$\langle x,y \rangle$$$，满足以下条件的非空向量序列 $$$\{a_i\}_{i=0}^n$$$ 的总数是多少：
$$$\{a_i\}$$$ 中的所有向量的元素均为整数。
此外，他还会给你 $$$Q$$$ 个询问，你需要对每个询问输出答案，模数为 $$$\mod 10^9 + 7$$$(一个质数)。

input.ai: 一个整数 $$$Q$$$，$$$1 \leq Q \leq 10^6$$$，表示查询的数量。随后给出 $$$Q$$$ 行，每行包含两个由空格分隔的整数 $$$x_i$$$ 和 $$$y_i$$$，$$$0 \leq |x_i|, |y_i| \leq 10^6$$$，表示第 $$$i$$$ 次查询。

output.ai: 在第 $$$i$$$ 行输出对于 $$$\langle x_i,y_i \rangle$$$ 满足上述性质的非空向量序列总数。
